definitions.de: Warm; eine angenehme, mäßige Temperatur habend, weder heiß noch kalt
definitions.en: Warm; having a pleasantly moderate temperature, neither hot nor cold
definitions.es: Cálido, tibio; que tiene una temperatura moderada y agradable, ni caliente ni frío
definitions.fr: Chaud, tiède; ayant une température modérée et agréable, ni chaud ni froid
definitions.hi: गरम, उष्ण; सुखद मध्यम तापमान वाला, न बहुत गर्म न ठंडा
definitions.ja: 温かい；快適な中程度の温度を持つ、暑くも寒くもない
definitions.km: កក់ក្តៅ; មានសីតុណ្ហភាពល្អទៅ មិនក្តៅហួស ហើយក៏មិនត្រជាក់ដែរ
definitions.ko: 따뜻한; 뜨겁지도 차갑지도 않은 쾌적한 적당한 온도를 가진
definitions.ne: न्यानो; सुखद मध्यम तापक्रम भएको, न धेरै गर्मी न चिसो
definitions.pt: Morno, quente; com uma temperatura moderada e agradável, nem quente nem frio
definitions.th: อุ่น; มีอุณหภูมิที่พอเหมาะและน่าสบาย ไม่ร้อนหรือเย็นเกินไป
definitions.tl: Mainit-init, maligamgam; may katamtamang temperatura na kasiya-siya, hindi mainit at hindi malamig
definitions.ur: گرم، نرم گرم؛ خوشگوار اعتدال پسند درجہ حرارت والا، نہ زیادہ گرم نہ ٹھنڈا
definitions.vi: Ấm; có nhiệt độ vừa phải dễ chịu, không nóng cũng không lạnh
definitions.zh: 温暖的；温度适中舒适，不热也不冷
definitions.zh_Hant: 溫暖的；溫度適中舒適，不熱也不冷

definition_en: Warm; having a pleasantly moderate temperature, neither hot nor cold

lao_examples.lao_script: ອາຫານຍັງອຸ່ນຢູ່ ກິນໄດ້ເລີຍ
lao_examples.romanization: Aa-haan yang un yuu, kin dai loei
lao_examples.translation_en: The food is still warm, you can eat right away.

lao_examples.lao_script: ອາກາດມື້ນີ້ອຸ່ນດີ ບໍ່ຮ້ອນເກີນໄປ
lao_examples.romanization: Aa-gaat muu-nii un dii, bo hon koen pai
lao_examples.translation_en: The weather today is nicely warm, not too hot.
